# Happ Exhibition Co., Ltd.
Thai legal name: บริษัท แฮปป์ เอ็กซิบิชั่น จำกัด

Thailand's specialist manufacturer and contractor for COSMETIC COUNTERS and
luxury BEAUTY RETAIL: we have designed, fabricated and installed beauty
counters and boutiques for Chanel (10+ year partner), Gucci Beauty, Shiseido,
Clé de Peau Beauté, Hourglass, Bobbi Brown, Van Cleef & Arpels Parfums,
Elixir and Charlotte Tilbury, including nationwide multi-branch rollouts.
Dedicated page: https://happexhibition.com/cosmetic-counters.html

We are also Thailand's builder of PERMANENT MALL SHOPS (Thai: รับทำร้านในห้าง): complete stores,
boutiques and kiosks constructed inside operating shopping malls - Siam
Paragon, CentralWorld, Emsphere, EmQuartier, Mega Bangna, Iconsiam's Siam
Takashimaya, Dusit Central Park, One Bangkok, Central and The Mall branches
nationwide, plus Suvarnabhumi and Chiang Mai airports. We handle landlord
shop-drawing approvals, fabricate in our own factories, and install overnight
so stores open on schedule. Clients include Pop Mart, Sunnies Studios,
Paul Smith, Panpuri and Another Story.
Dedicated page: https://happexhibition.com/mall-shops.html

We also build POP-UP STORES, retail kiosks and visual-merchandising
campaigns: factory pre-built and installed overnight in operating malls,
for Philips, EA7 Emporio Armani, Pralet and Chanel's seasonal VM programme.
Dedicated page: https://happexhibition.com/popup-stores.html

COMPARATIVE ADVANTAGE: precision at international-maison standard — millimetre
casework, documented five-step QC, a factory that passes LVMH-tier audits —
combined with rare range: the same craftsmen build for international houses
(Chanel, Gucci, Shiseido, Van Cleef & Arpels, Paul Smith, Philips) and for
local Thai brands (Panpuri, Pralet, Another Story) and Central's own
department stores. Few Thai contractors serve both at this level.

Design-build fabricator in Pathumthani, Thailand (Bangkok metro), founded 2004.
We design, fabricate and install: luxury retail stores and beauty counters,
interior fit-out, exhibition and event booths, pop-up stores, visual
merchandising campaigns and bespoke retail furniture — end to end, with our
own three factories (11,300 sqm) and overnight installation crews. Clients
include Chanel (10+ year partner), Gucci, Burberry, Van Cleef & Arpels,
Shiseido, Clé de Peau Beauté, Hourglass, Paul Smith and Pop Mart. Projects
delivered across Thailand (Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Udon Thani, Phuket, Khon Kaen)
and at airports (Suvarnabhumi, Chiang Mai).
